summary: First full run at 390x844. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (stats, create/get husband, validation, card upload, og.jpg, card.png, share HTML). The Claude Sonnet 5.5 vows work (vows_source=llm, ~2-5s), and the template fallback kicked in correctly on an LLM 429 concurrency error. Frontend: found one CRITICAL blocker. On Strand V, moving any slider and then tapping 'Next: what he remembers' left a blank page: the URL changed to /strand/6, but the Temperament <main> stayed at opacity 0 and Strand VI never mounted. Removing the framer-motion `layout` prop from the so-far tags fixed it, and the full flow was retested. Everything else passed: welcome counter and how-it-works sheet, disabled/enabled next button, I/VII roman progress, answers kept on back (option and custom text), 3-step slider captions, so-far tags, remembers max 3 plus custom chip, weaving tags and strand count with auto-navigate, skip-to-him, Meet ribbon/5 vows/number/signature, Share him desktop fallback (1080x1920 PNG download, 'Link copied' toast, /api/share/{id} on the clipboard), card uploaded to backend, Tell recipient and strand chips, signature input, copy link toast, public /h/:id with weave-your-own, friendly not-found for an invalid id. No horizontal overflow and no tap targets under 44px on any screen.

minor.issue: Strings inside strands, feel and keys can be empty or whitespace and still pass validation; only list length is checked.
No auth or ownership check and the first upload wins, so anyone who knows the id can upload any PNG and set the OG image permanently.
The Emergent key returns 429 CONCURRENCY_REQUEST_LIMIT when two requests run in parallel. The template fallback covers it, but concurrent users will silently get template vows.

ui_bugs.component: Temperament.jsx (Strand V) -> Strand VI route transition
ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. After any slider change, tapping next-remembers-button left the page blank: the old <main> stayed at opacity:0 with transform translateY(-8px), and the AnimatePresence mode='wait' exit never finished. Cause: `layout` prop on the so-far tag motion.span chips, whose keys change when sliders move. Removing `layout` fixed it (2/2 reproduced before the fix, 3/3 passed after).

integration_issues.issue: The card is uploaded only from /meet/:id, after a background render of about 5-8s. If the user shares or copies the link and leaves before that finishes, /api/husbands/{id}/og.jpg stays 404 and link previews have no image. Also, anyone visiting /meet/:id (isOwner is always true) can trigger the upload.

issues: The band lines on the wicker figure (band-line-0..2) shrink to about 5-7px and can't be read at 390px.
Refreshing /weaving after a husband was created posts again and makes a duplicate husband (counter goes up).

action_items: Review the tester's fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/Temperament.jsx (removed `layout` from the so-far tag motion.span). Do not re-add `layout` inside pages wrapped by AnimatePresence mode='wait', or move to a different animation approach.
Consider uploading the card as soon as it renders and before sharing, or rendering the OG image on the server, so og.jpg is never missing.
Optional: reject empty strings in HusbandIn strands and feel, and limit card upload to the session that created the husband.
Optional: make the cameo band text bigger or readable.
critical_code_review_comments: Meet.jsx useCardPng(h, true): isOwner is hardcoded to true, so any non-public /meet/:id visit uploads the card.
Weaving.jsx: there is no guard against re-creating a husband on reload; consider caching the created id in sessionStorage.
server.py llm_vows: a new LlmChat is created per request, which is fine; the 8s timeout and the vows_ok validation work as designed.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (one critical navigation blocker found and fixed by tester; the rest passes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with -n0, because test_stats_increments fails under xdist parallelism. The sessionStorage key 'weave-him-answers' can be pre-seeded to jump straight to /strand/5, 6 or 7. The Strand V->VI blank-page bug only happens after a slider change; re-check it if Temperament.jsx animations change.
rca of the issue: Repro: open /strand/5, change any slider (page.fill on [data-testid=slider-out]), then click next-remembers-button. The URL becomes /strand/6, but the DOM still shows the Temperament page at opacity 0 and Remembers never mounts. Root cause: framer-motion 11.18 with React 19. The so-far chips are `motion.span layout` with keys t+i, and those keys change when a slider step changes. During the route exit, the layout-animated children keep the parent AnimatePresence (mode='wait') from finishing its exit, so the next route never renders. Fix: remove `layout` (applied by the tester).
